qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual covers spark plug torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-2 Engine Electrical System, subsection 12 12 Spark plugs

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M12x1.25 and M14x1.25 spark plugs?
qa_pairs.answer: The M14x1.25 spark plugs require 7 Nm more torque (30 ± 3 Nm) compared to M12x1.25 spark plugs (23 ± 3 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: Do both spark plug sizes use the same torque tolerance?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both M12x1.25 and M14x1.25 spark plugs use a tolerance of ± 3 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What unit is used for measuring spark plug torque specifications?
Are these torque specifications applicable to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the specifications show 'All' in the Type column for both spark plug sizes
